# Kamsu Ravi Teeja (Ravi Teeja K)

> Kamsu Ravi Teeja, also written Ravi Teeja K or Kamsu Raviteja, is a Forward Deployed Engineer at Qdrant. He designs and ships production vector search, RAG and multi-agent AI systems, working remotely from India.

## Quick facts
- Current role: Forward Deployed Engineer at Qdrant (since April 2026)
- Previously: AI Engineer at Lyzr AI (2025-2026); Founding Software Engineer at GradeHive AI, now Deepdocs (2024-2025); Software Engineer Intern at Tooljet (2024); Developer Intern at Hoppscotch (2023)
- Focus: vector search, hybrid search, retrieval-augmented generation, AI agents, full-stack TypeScript and Python
- Outside work: football, basketball, Telugu cinema, Power Rangers
- Location: Remote, India
